environment.note: wave-06 B3 sealed copy and host boundary

cases.title: the capsule is a full copy without any Git surface
detail: copied 2 file(s); no .git, no remote config, no hooks in the capsule

cases.title: capsule files never share an inode with the author checkout
detail: every file was copied, none hardlinked

cases.title: a hardlink that would modify the author copy is refused or detected
detail: the filesystem allows a hardlink into the capsule; only copying bytes defends the frozen source

cases.title: an escaping symlink in the capsule cannot reach the author home
detail: links are not replicated into a capsule (probe link resolvable=true); the copy step skips them

cases.title: the reviewer may write scratch in the capsule; the frozen source is unchanged
detail: scratch was writable and discarded; the author working files were never modified

cases.title: changing the frozen input invalidates the original subject evidence
detail: the mutated tree no longer matches the frozen digest, so it cannot prove the original candidate

cases.title: host files/credentials remain reachable, so the copy is not a sandbox
detail: confirmed cwd/copy is not a sandbox: the author home is reachable by absolute path, so host restrictions must be enforced separately

cases.title: the capsule manifest binds the frozen subject and its own file digests
detail: the manifest is bound to the frozen subject and every recorded file digest still matches

cases.title: the disposable capsule is removed after the run
detail: capsule tree removed; nothing shared with the author remains
